## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2025-11-19: S-1/A No. 1 files form-of TRA as Exhibit 10.4 (preamble blank)
- 2025-12-16: Reorganization closes; TRA executed
- 2025-12-22: IPO-close 8-K files executed TRA as Exhibit 10.3

## Explanation

Andersen Group Inc.'s Tax Receivable Agreement was executed on December 16, 2025 at the closing of its Up-C IPO, committing PubCo to pay 85% of the cash tax savings it realizes from (i) Section 754 basis step-ups generated when Andersen Aggregator LLC exchanges or redeems Class X Umbrella Units of AT Umbrella LLC for Class A common stock or cash, and (ii) imputed-interest deductions on the TRA payments themselves. Mark L. Vorsatz signed on behalf of all three entity parties. No amendments or terminations appear, and the firm has not yet recognized a TRA liability as of the Q1 2026 10-Q because no qualifying exchanges have produced realized tax benefits yet. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
